sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A minute, rounded, yellow-brown moss, usually only about 1–2 mm tall. Its upper leaves surround and partly conceal a spherical capsule on an extremely short stalk. It grows on open bare soil, including cultivated fields, gravel pits, tracksides, banks and anthills; British records note a preference for slightly acidic disturbed soils.

sections.title: Uses and safety
sections.text: The sources consulted do not document food or medicinal use, or specific toxicity information.
